summary: NetApp filed an 8-K reporting fiscal Q4 2026 results and announcing a $1.0B share repurchase authorization. The new buyback has no expiration date; repurchases may be executed via open-market (Rule 10b-18), 10b5-1 plans, privately-negotiated transactions, or accelerated share repurchases. No specific price per share, premium, or close date is stated. The board authorized the repurchase; no financial advisor is named. The program offers flexibility but no commitment. Watch for the pace of execution under the renewed buyback authorization; the lack of set terms leaves the rate of capital return uncertain.
